summary: Parliamentary privilege vs bribery; interpretation of Articles 105(2) and 194(2); immunity not applicable to bribery; bribery not protected as 'anything said' or 'vote given'; functional analysis of privilege; collective right of House; necessity test for privilege; probity in public life; parallel jurisdiction of courts and House; international comparisons (UK, US, Canada, Australia); Rajya Sabha elections under Article 194(2); PV Narasimha Rao judgment doubted and referred to larger bench.
final_judgment: Referred to seven-judge bench; prima facie doubts over PV Narasimha Rao judgment; reconsideration ordered regarding immunity for legislators accepting bribes.
